decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The brick to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby approved shall be 'Hurstwood Multi', Received 8 August 2011, and shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Design and Access Statement, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 24A, 25A, 26A, 30A, 31A, 32A, 33A, 35A, 36A, 38, Received 4 July 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the rear extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a roof extension incorporating a mansard roof, parapet and a roof terrace to both houses.
